import sys

def fast_pow(base, exp, p):
    result = 1
    while exp > 0:
        if exp & 1:
            result = (result * base) % p
        base = (base * base) % p
        exp >>= 1
    return result

def combination(a, b, fac, invfac, p):
    return (fac[a] * invfac[b] % p) * invfac[a - b] % p

def triangle_sum(x, p):
    return (x * (x + 1) // 2) % p

def main():
    input = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    n, m, p = map(int, input[:3])
    # Initialize factorials and inverse factorials
    fac = [1] * 501
    for i in range(1, 501):
        fac[i] = (fac[i - 1] * i) % p
    invfac = [1] * 501
    invfac[500] = fast_pow(fac[500], p - 2, p)
    for i in range(499, -1, -1):
        invfac[i] = (invfac[i + 1] * (i + 1)) % p

    cnt = [0] * 505
    dp = [0] * 505
    cnt[0] = 1
    dp[0] = 0
    cnt[1] = 2
    dp[1] = 0

    for i in range(2, m + 1):
        for j in range(1, i + 1):
            zh = combination(i - 1, j - 1, fac, invfac, p)
            tmp = (cnt[j - 1] * cnt[i - j] % p) * zh % p
            val1 = (dp[j - 1] * cnt[i - j]) % p
            val2 = (dp[i - j] * cnt[j - 1]) % p
            sum_tri_j_1 = triangle_sum(j - 1, p)
            sum_tri_i_j = triangle_sum(i - j, p)
            dp[i] = (dp[i] + tmp * sum_tri_j_1 + zh * j % p * (val1 + val2) % p) % p
            cnt[i] = (cnt[i] + tmp * j) % p
            dp[i] = (dp[i] + tmp * sum_tri_i_j + zh * (i - j + 1) % p * (val1 + val2) % p) % p
            cnt[i] = (cnt[i] + tmp * (i - j + 1)) % p

    dp2 = [[0] * (m + 1) for _ in range(n + 1)]
    tot = [[0] * (m + 1) for _ in range(n + 1)]
    for i in range(n + 1):
        for j in range(m + 1):
            if i == 0 and j == 0:
                dp2[i][j] = 0
                tot[i][j] = 1
            else:
                dp2[i][j] = 0
                tot[i][j] = 0

    for i in range(1, n + 1):
        for j in range(0, min(m, i) + 1):
            dp2[i][j] = dp2[i - 1][j]
            tot[i][j] = tot[i - 1][j]
            for k in range(1, j + 1):
                if k < i:
                    zh = combination(j, k, fac, invfac, p)
                    val1 = (dp[k] * zh * tot[i - k - 1][j - k]) % p
                    val2 = (dp2[i - k - 1][j - k] * zh * cnt[k]) % p
                    dp2[i][j] = (dp2[i][j] + val1 + val2) % p
                    tot[i][j] = (tot[i][j] + cnt[k] * tot[i - k - 1][j - k] * zh) % p
                else:
                    dp2[i][j] = (dp2[i][j] + dp[i]) % p
                    tot[i][j] = (tot[i][j] + cnt[i]) % p

    print(dp2[n][m])

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
